camel_example: aliyun oceanbasepro ModifyTenantUserPassword --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId t4pnum0000 --UserName pay_test --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --UserPassword '!Aliyun4Oceanbase'
description_en: Modifies the logon password of a specified database account under a tenant
description_zh: 修改租户下指定的数据库账号的登录密码
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro modify-tenant-user-password --user-name pay_test --tenant-id t4pnum0000 --user-password '!Aliyun4Oceanbase' --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTenantUserPassword

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database account.
Certain reserved keywords such as SYS and root cannot be used
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号名称。
不能使用某些预留关键字，如 SYS、root 等
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The logon password of the database account.
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The password must be 10 to 32 characters in length. Supported special characters are: !@#$%^&* ()_ +-=
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号访问密码。
必须包含大写英文字符、小写英文字符、数字、特殊字符占三种，长度为 10-32 位； 特殊字符为：!@#$%^&* ()_ +-=
parameters.name: user_password
